policy: Factual-final diagnostic: exclude independently supported ambiguous or defensible alternatives, equal correct factual finals, missing required inputs/conventions, malformed choices, or cases with actual counterexamples to both proposals. Preserve official labels on every retained pair. Format and reasoning preferences can remain defensible in the official metric; their exclusion here does not declare the official preference wrong. This is a conditional diagnostic subset, not a corrected full-benchmark accuracy. All selected questions and factual finals are reviewed after freeze without tonight's labels or judgement outcomes; source checks and independent computation support the listed decisions.

excluded.reason: Both D and J say the trade evidence is admissible to explain the contractual meaning. D states the general rule; J describes a possible latent ambiguity. Trade usage can explain or supplement a final writing; this audit treats J as a defensible explanation, without claiming an ambiguity prerequisite.
Both selected statements are false: meiosis normally creates four haploid cells, and sister chromatids separate in meiosis II. The NOT-true stem therefore admits both A and C.

Gene flow both homogenizes populations (H) and reduces their likelihood of speciation (C). A repeats C six times and B repeats H five times; that formatting distinction remains in the official ablation but this subset audits factual final answers.

D names the muscles producing movement; J names the segmented flexible-joint structure permitting movement despite an exoskeleton. Both are defensible responses to the unqualified mechanism question; neither asserts an incompatible mechanism.

Both code lists are uniquely decodable because each codeword begins with one ternary delimiter and then only binary digits. Both attain the lower-bound expected length 95/69. Exhaustive length-four concatenations have no collisions. Evidence: jb-results/test-arithmetic-audit.json, index15.

B is false because subtraction and division are not commutative; D is false because round-to-nearest finite floating-point arithmetic is not associative. Executed counterexamples give 4-2 != 2-4 and different associations of 1e16,-1e16,1. Evidence: test-arithmetic-audit.json, index16.

J is defensible: symphyseal fusion occurs in the first year. D is also defensible: longitudinal studies show horizontal foramen movement during growth, though movement varies by reference frame and sample.

B explains the lower density of ice by its hydrogen-bonded lattice. E describes the resulting pressure-favored melting. Both explain the negative solid-liquid equilibrium slope; the alternatives differ in causal level.

A and H can hold simultaneously for a very weak base: pKb=14 and moderate aqueous concentration gives pOH near7. The question specifies neither a base constant nor concentration and gives no quantitative definition of very weak. A selects H; B selects A. This is a defensible-overlap diagnostic, not an assertion that either relation holds for every possible solution.

Both D and H describe a C3 plant-food to grass-associated C4 resource transition. The isotope evidence distinguishes photosynthetic pathways, not a unique choice between the broad initial food descriptions nuts/fruits and fruits/vegetables.

Both H and D are established halves of the audience effect: easier well-learned tasks improve; difficult or novel tasks can worsen. The stem asks for an effect and does not require one option combining both.

DAT-5 and GATB are both aptitude/career-assessment batteries, making I and D defensible under the ordinary purpose-based classification. Publisher scope supports this reading. It does not prove that neither instrument is ever used secondarily in a malingering investigation.

B contrasts evolutionary origins with learned behavior; D contrasts innate aggression with social learning. Both express the inherited-versus-learned theoretical contrast at different levels of specificity.
Both C and I distinguish sensory sensitivity from an observer decision criterion or motivation. C is brief; I is expanded. Their selected conceptual contrasts are defensible.

Christianity/Buddhism and Islam/Sikhism both fit a published universalizing-religion classification. Sikhism is expressly listed among other universalizing religions in the cited geography course. The audit is bounded to that classification; missionary practice and ethnicity can be described differently in other sources.
Ajiva is explicitly defined as both non-living and non-soul by the Jain sources. D and B are translations of the same category.

Non-specialized resources and equally productive resources both give constant opportunity cost in the standard two-good linear PPF model. D and I describe compatible sufficient conditions. This is bounded to that standard interpretation of equally productive, not an arbitrary production technology.

The exact limit is 1+0.5*ln(2*pi)=1.9189385332, under the intended normal-density interpretation. Neither final 1.4 nor1.1 is correct; even the closest listed option is1.8. A has the right symbolic formula before a wrong numeric evaluation. Evidence: test-arithmetic-audit.json, index56.
The color model is not specified. Blue is complementary to yellow in RGB/additive color and to orange in the artist RYB wheel. The two candidates select those different conventions.

The rendered exponent-minus notation is damaged and the listed work values use positive exponents. For the intended 1e-10m to5e-10m separation, work is about8.1e-58J gravitationally and1.84e-18J electrically, not the positive powers printed in any option. Evidence: test-arithmetic-audit.json, index74.

For the stated circular-aperture Airy pattern, the first secondary maximum is about0.01749786 of the central intensity. No printed option matches; the smallest is0.125. Interpreting the unusual word diagonal as secondary still gives this mismatch. Executed Bessel-series check: test-arithmetic-audit.json, index79.

Irreversibility in energy units is T0*Sgen, but ambient temperature T0 is absent. The supplied data give Sgen=1.4799987kJ/K;441.1kJ assumes about298K, while505.5kJ assumes about341.55K. Neither ambient is specified. Evidence: test-arithmetic-audit.json, index84.

The255-dollar lump sum is specified by Social Security rules, but the monthly survivor amount depends on the deceased worker primary insurance amount, prior reduction, claiming age and applicable computation. A62-year age plus average annual earnings does not identify a dated benefit formula or full earnings record. The200.50 versus206.80 choice is under-specified.
The question explicitly requires a rate schedule from a previous problem, which is absent. The six-ad cost cannot be derived from the supplied input.

For nums=[1,1],m=3, both returnFalse, but splitting into two singletons is explicitly permitted, soTrue is correct. A additionally handles n=1 correctly; B does not. The official preference for fewer bugs may be defensible, but neither is a fully correct program. Actual proposal executions are in test-code-audit.json.

For usageLimits=[1,1,50], both fail: the maximum is2groups, while A returns3 and B returns9. Distinct members prevent reusing the dominant number within a group. With [10], B returns4 rather than1. Actual proposal executions are in test-code-audit.json.

A rejects the valid supplied sample [8,4,2,30,15]. B accepts [8,3,1], but the middle3 prevents the1-bit numbers8 and1 from crossing. Both have valid-input counterexamples. Actual proposal executions are in test-code-audit.json.

qualified_retained.reason: Stream-cipher terminology can include a one-time-pad boundary case, but a long key alone does not guarantee random single-use secrecy. No unconditional equally correct alternative is established.
The protein-to-energy requirement question specifically favors protein density. A broader most-susceptible claim is not independently established.
Viral apoptosis and lysis both occur; this review does not establish an equally valid most-common claim across the unspecified viral population.

A hurricane angular-momentum estimate needs a mass/wind integration model. No independent primary measurement is acquired that establishes either competing numerical alternative. Uncertainty alone does not exclude it.
The NOT-listed public-relations quality question does not identify its source list. No alternative authoritative list is verified, so no exclusion is made.

A full aqueous-solubility model would include water autoionization and pH, while the usual textbook Ksp exercise suppresses that correction. The review retains the intended simplified model rather than imposing a new chemistry requirement.

A is functionally correct on the executed case but uses linear-time list insertion. B uses a balanced-container library unavailable in the audit sandbox. The library-dependent boundary behavior is unverified here; this gap does not relabel B or establish an equal complete answer.

Both Dijkstra algorithms give the correct small example; A scans the full edge table and B traverses adjacency lists. Their repeated per-character shortest paths need a boundary runtime check. A sample pass alone does not establish equivalence across all constraints.
